prompt:
Square scientific hand-therapy instructional chart, FIVE independent large white contour drawings, arranged three across the upper half, two centered across the lower half. Each mini drawing has only its own large numeral 1,2,3,4,5 in sequential reading order centered beneath it. No other text or panel borders. It must teach FIVE genuinely distinct finger joint postures even after scaling down to phone size. Draw only the hand and a short segment of forearm, no face, torso, sleeve, or other hand. Use the provided picture for this app's WHITE LINE STYLE ONLY (do not repeat the pose). All panels use consistent size, exactly four fingers and one thumb, same hand and same clean oblique SIDE VIEW looking at index-finger edge; thumb stays relaxed and clear of other fingers. Show the profile of the nearest index finger's joint angles WITH the other three fingers naturally staggered behind, four fingers all take the SAME posture in each panel. The upright palm remains aligned over a vertical forearm in all five, wrist neutral. Palmar side faces RIGHT on the page. Give each pose its own unmistakable silhouette:
1 Open: all finger segments completely STRAIGHT, fingertips point straight UP.
2 Hook: base knuckles stay STRAIGHT in line with the vertical palm, long proximal segments pointing UP; then bend the middle and end finger joints, so fingertips curl downward like a hook and reach near the top of the palm. The proximal phalanges are still VERTICAL, producing a tall narrow hook shape, NOT a full fist.
3 Full fist: bend the base knuckles, middle AND tip joints. Short compact clenched silhouette with a horizontal shelf of bent knuckles, fingertips curled tightly IN to palm, thumb outside fingers.
4 Tabletop: all BASE knuckles bend 90°, all finger joints beyond them remain completely straight, so all four fingers stick STRAIGHT HORIZONTALLY out to the RIGHT, like a flat shelf with straight long fingers. Wrist and palm remain VERTICAL. Thumb relaxed below shelf. Show no bend at any finger tip.
5 Long/straight fist: BASE knuckles bend about 90°, first finger segments make a shelf to the RIGHT; middle joints also bend 90° so middle and distal finger segments point DOWN toward the base of the palm. Last joints remain STRAIGHT and fingernails visible along the downward fingertips in PROFILE. Shape like a squared inverted U with flat tips pointing down and reaching the heel of the hand; it differs visually from #2 (its base knuckles are bent), from #3 (tip joints straight here), from #4 (middle finger joints bent here). Keep thumb unobtrusive so distal joints remain visible. Show the four fingertips pointing DOWN, not hooked back.
Fit all five hands with wide separation and all five numerals. Sparse uniform crisp white unfilled contour strokes thick enough for 300px display. Genuinely transparent RGBA both outside and INSIDE everything. No lighting, hatching, shadows, colored skin or filled shapes, black linework, motion trails, background, arrows, underlays or bars. Depict the right hand of an adult woman, natural proportions, modest nails.
